overview: Diye gaye combinational aur sequential circuit ka output/function/state sequence nikaalna.
coreConcept: Combinational: gate-by-gate Boolean expression; sequential: flip-flop next-state equations se state trace.
hinglishExplanation: Combinational me har gate ka output likhkar simplify karo ya truth table banao. Sequential me pehle flip-flop ke input equations, phir initial state se clock-by-clock next state. Fault detection me faulty aur fault-free output alag karne wala input dhundo.
formalDefinition: Combinational: gate-by-gate Boolean expression; sequential: flip-flop next-state equations se state trace.
importantProperties: Combinational: output = function(inputs), koi memory nahi.
D FF: Q+ = D; T FF: Q+ = Q xor T; JK: Q+ = JQ' + K'Q.
Synchronous clock par sab FF ek saath update.
Shift register/counter: state sequence trace se pehchano.
Stuck-at fault detect karne ke liye input jo fault-free aur faulty output me farak de.
Steady state wale sawal me feedback equation solve.
commonPitfalls: Old state se next state nikalne ki jagah naye se mix.
Diagram ki labelling padhne me galti.
standardTechniques: Har gate ka output label karo.
Sequential: table (present state, input, next state).
